current_stances.position: Ubique reinforces its view that specific physical gestures—such as firm mouth closure, lip protrusion, nose‑up movement, and spitting—reflect evolutionary adaptations linked to physical preparation, exertion, and social signaling during contempt and disgust.
Ubique reinforces its view that tear secretion during emotional crying involves coordinated autonomic and mechanical pathways.
